title: sky Landscape Infrared vision
description: changes your sky to another sky
body:
This texture pack shows a beautiful and unusual landscape. In the foreground and across the hills, the grass and vegetation appear bright red and pink, which gives the scene a surreal and dreamlike look. The land is gently rolling with soft hills covered in this colorful plant life.

In the middle of the image, there is a calm lake with smooth, reflective water. The water has a cool bluish tone, which contrasts with the warm red colors of the surrounding vegetation. The surface of the lake looks peaceful and still.

In the background, more rounded hills stretch toward the horizon. They are also covered with the same pink and red plants. Above everything, the sky is clear and pale blue without clouds, creating a quiet and serene atmosphere.

Overall, the image looks like a fantasy or infrared-style landscape, where nature appears in unusual colors, making the scene feel magical and otherworldly
use optifine mod to make the sky work
